svg.title: Three bands, one per tier of evidence that can establish a net's role. The naming convention and the source format both run at read time. A datasheet pin table runs later, at model construction. Each band ends in the RoleSource the value is stamped with, so a role read off a naming convention stays distinguishable from one a vendor's pin table established. A later tier may only add a value, never remove or downgrade one.
svg.text: one net, three tiers that can establish its role

g.text: a power symbol, a net class

svg.text: each value records the tier that established it, so a convention and a vendor fact never look alike
and a later tier may only add, so no tier's absence can quietly narrow an answer
